english.title: Enter / attempt to enter the Midland Metro whilst intoxicated / under influence of an illegal substance
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[entered]_
(B)_[attempted to enter]_

the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) whilst

(C)_[in a state of intoxication]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 7(2) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Note the powers of the authorised officer under byelaw 7(2) to require a person to leave the Metro forthwith if he or she reasonably believes that person to be intoxicated or under the influence of the effects of any illegal substance
